articles.title: Crypto stocks sink after Senate rejects Clarity Act
articles.snippet: Coinbase, Circle and Galaxy lead a broad crypto stock selloff after the U.S. Senate failed to advance a long-awaited market structure bill.

articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act barrels toward disappointment barring last-minute Senate turnaround
articles.snippet: As the parties dig in their heels, the market structure bill hasn't yet amassed the votes it would need to clear the first Senate hurdle scheduled for Tuesday.

articles.title: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
articles.snippet: The 12-month test will put a beta version of the central bank currency through online, mobile, in-store and peer-to-peer payments.

articles.title: Clarity Act's odds of passing plunge as Republicans reject Democrats' counter-proposal
articles.snippet: Prediction markets sharply marked down the crypto market structure bill’s near-term prospects as negotiations remained stuck hours before a key Senate vote.

articles.title: A hacker turned 25 cents of bitcoin into 46 billion fake BTC tokens on a DeFi bridge
articles.snippet: Two software bugs allowed the attacker to create more than 2,000 times Bitcoin’s maximum supply in unbacked syBTC. Symbiosis puts preliminary losses at 9.97 BTC.
